source.text: 9.3 Where the Buyer places a single Purchase Order for twenty (20) or more units of Equipment, the Vendor shall allow the Buyer a discount of 4% on the price of that Purchase Order, and the invoice shall show the discounted amount.
The Buyer shall settle each undisputed invoice within 30 days of the invoice date, by bank transfer or crossed cheque to the account that the Vendor has notified to the Buyer in writing.

The Parties have agreed that the Cisco Catalyst 9300 Switch shall be supplied at a unit price of PKR 540,000, and the Vendor shall not invoice the Buyer for that item at any amount higher than that unit price, whatever the market conditions at the time of the Purchase Order or of delivery.
